### Live Like Sons and Daughters of the King
Author: Marshall Segal
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/live-like-sons-and-daughters-of-the-king
Passage: Galatians 4:4-7
Points:
- Human culture conditions people to earn approval, tempting believers to treat God like an employer rather than a Father.
- By sending His Son, God redeemed those under the law and granted eternal safety from judgment.
- God sent the Spirit into believers' hearts, establishing deep personal intimacy to cry out to Him.
- Believers are no longer slaves but heirs, promised an eternal inheritance whose greatest treasure is God Himself.

### Christmas According to the Apostle Paul
Author: R. Fowler White
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/articles/christmas-according-apostle-paul
Passage: Galatians 4:4-5
Points:
- Christ's arrival occurred precisely at the sovereignly appointed moment prepared throughout human history.
- The eternal Son humbled Himself to be born of a woman, taking on genuine humanity.
- Born under the law, Jesus rendered perfect obedience to fulfill all legal requirements as our surety.
- His redemption pays the price of sin to grant believers the legal standing and privileges of adopted heirs.
